mo_ta_cong_viec:
About the Company: GrapeSEED is part of the GrapeCity family of companies, delivering international English curriculum to children aged 4–12. Our technology suite is used by teachers, students, parents, and staff for instruction, progress tracking, and operational efficiency. As part of our platform modernization, we are strengthening our data engineering capability across our global teams.
Role Summary:
Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines and workflows
Build and maintain robust data infrastructure, including data lakes and data warehouses
Collaborate with the Data Engineering Lead, Solution Architect, and cross-functional global teams to deliver data solutions
Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all data systems
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure reliability and performance
Implement best practices for ETL processes and data modeling
yeu_cau:
Your skills and experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
At least 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, including senior-level responsibility
Experience with dimensional modeling
Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala
Hands-on experience with big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) and cloud platforms, especially AWS data engineering services (Azure is a plus)
Expertise in relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra), with strong SQL proficiency
Proficiency in ETL tools and data pipeline frameworks
Experience with Docker / Kubernetes; knowledge of CI/CD for data pipelines
Proficient English communication (our working language across global teams)
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, high professional ethics and responsibility
